ResonanceMain.id1:
1. On the left side of the resonance, you can put in a character of SR/SSR/UR quality who is level 1 or higher as the main hero
2. After putting in the main character, you can put in another level 1 character of lower quality than the main character as the resonance character
3. The level, physical attribute percentage, potential level, equipment, weapon, permanent pointer, shell, and Haki of the resonance character will always be the same as the main character
4. If the star level of the resonant character is lower than that of the main character, the stats of the resonance hero will be raised to the stat value corresponding to the star level of the main character (up to 5 stars for SR characters) under the current quality
5. The skill level and bond of the resonance character will remain the same and can be activated by awakening and bond activation normally. 
6. When the star level of the main character is raised, the resonance level of all characters will be raised at the same time and after a certain level all of the player’s character’s awakening levels will also be raised
 7. When the star level of the main character is lowered due to replacement or respawn, the resonance level will also be lowered
8. Removing the main character will restore the status of the resonance character
 9. Removing the resonant character will restore the content that is consistent with the main character
10. Characters in the same resonance chamber cannot be in battle at the same time 
11. Resonance characters cannot be used as characters on demand when they break the character limit 
12. When players reach a certain level, they can unlock additional character attributes through the total stats, which is the total qualification of 15 resonance bits 
13. When a player unlocks an attribute, the unlocked attribute is still in effect when the player plays a resonance character, resulting in a stats that is less than the qualification required for the unlocked attribute

GVGBase.introduction:
· Event available every Monday: Island Survival. Players from three Guilds match to compete on the same map to be the last one standing. 

· When the game begins, players from three Guilds are distributed randomly on the map, and the Poison Circle starts to shrink. As time goes by, the Safety Zone will shrink. 

· The Circle will shrink at every 10:00, settlement is at 22:00. When settling, players in the Poison will be judged dead 

· Items, relics and points are randomly distributed on the map, and you can kill and loot the items and points of the players from other Guilds. 

·You may gift the items and legacy items to the teammates of the same Guild. A teammate can be gifted with up to one item or legacy item daily 

• You can gift all your points to the teammates of the same Guild, attempts unlimited 

· When the game begins every Monday, the Offline Protection Mechanism will be activated, items and points of the players offline will not be looted. Spend 1 Action Point and the Offline Protection Mechanism will be removed. 

• When reborn after the Offline Protection Mechanism is removed, a temporary grid of woods will be shown at your reborn spot, which disappears when you move.
